TextView.android:text: The countdown timer runs continuously for the entire test. You can freely allocate your time between reading the passage and answering questions.
The standardized reading passage is accessible at all times using the 'View Passage' toggle above the question card.
Evaluates official DepEd Phil-IRI reading proficiency levels: Independent (80%–100%), Instructional (59%–79%), and Frustration (≤ 58%).
When the timer reaches 00:00, the assessment automatically locks and submits all recorded answers.
Learner can read and comprehend the text completely without teacher assistance. Ready for advanced enrichment texts.
